action.prompt: Before executing any bash command, check if it contains "python " (python followed by a space) as a command invocation. If it does, rewrite the command to use "python3" instead of "python". For example, "python application.py" should become "python3 application.py", and "python -m pytest" should become "python3 -m pytest". Do not modify occurrences of "python" that are already "python3", or where "python" appears in a path or as part of another word.
